title: CIA-UAP-D021, Analysis of Unconventional Aircraft Sightings, 1955
doc_notes: This document is a 1955 CIA memorandum discussing the analysis of unconventional aircraft sightings and referencing a specific 1954 incident, while also noting contemporary aerospace development programs.

incidents.summary: Two lights were observed rising vertically and passing above the observers at a high altitude.
incidents.quote: two lights which initially appeared at the train and then rose at a high altitude
